newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia 182-day t-bill average yield at 6.292 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia 182-day t-bill average yield at 6.292 pct.

text.p: Malaysia accepted bids at an average yield of 6.292 percent at its auction of 182-day treasury bills for 100 million ringgit, Bank Negara said on Thursday.
At its previous auction of 182-day treasury bills on March 6 for a similar amount, the central bank accepted bids at an average yield of 6.298 percent.
The bids accepted were in the high/low range of 6.305/6.273 percent against 6.344/6.270 percent previously.
The central bank said it will issue 364-day treasury bills for 100 million ringgit on March 27.
